description: nhflow_2d_beach_suspended_mpi2 with the inertia stress of the grains S 37 1: rho cm cv cn d50 du/dt from the acceleration of the bottom-layer velocity between two sediment steps (bedshear::bed_acceleration, both components, limited to 0.3 g, zero in dry columns), added to the bed shear stress as a vector. Before, the term was the magnitude of the acceleration times S 21 d50 and only the RK2 momentum solver filled it.
